title: Likely7/Veyra-NRVideo
lede: Veyra is a Windows app that runs video files, images, capture cards and game streams through a real-time GPU pipeline of super resolution, denoising, HDR and frame generation.

points: Sources include local files, capture cards, PS5 Remote Play, Sunshine-based PC streaming, experimental Xbox support and screen capture.
Offers RTX Video, DLSS, XeSS and FSR super resolution, up to four layered neural denoising passes, and frame generation.
A node editor builds custom processing chains; list mode handles export to MP4 or MKV.
Written in C++ on DirectX 12 for Windows 11, with separate NVIDIA and AMD portable packages.
Release 2.1.5 smooths frame pacing after capture deduplication.

points.text: GPU load: one report shows near-full use on an RTX 4090 with 4K super resolution, denoising and 2x frame generation together.
Frame generation on RTX 3000 series cards is still an open thread.
Users ask how to apply frame interpolation to video playing in a web browser.
Subtitle bugs, such as SRT cues losing text after a comma.
